hooks.command: R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; { echo "Session resumed after compaction. Working state:"; echo "Branch: $(git -C "$R" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"; echo "Uncommitted files:"; git -C "$R" status --porcelain | head -25; echo "Recent commits:"; git -C "$R" log --oneline -5; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}' 2>/dev/null || true
